Hi Daniel / Sophie — thanks for the quick responses.

A couple of practical notes on the MSA / redline sequencing to keep the timeline tight:

1) Priority clauses to resolve first (commercial + risk):
   - Fees & payment terms (we can accept standard Net 30; if procurement needs Net 45/60 please flag early).
   - SLA & remedies: propose we include p90 latency target and an objective metric for uptime in the pilot appendix; full production SLA can follow.
   - Liability cap: propose mutual cap at 1x annualized pilot value (open to negotiation for enterprise deal).

2) Second-pass clauses: IP definitions, detailed indemnities, and insurance schedules.

3) Turn times — if Acme routes MSA to contracts team with a prioritized redline set (commercial + SLA), our legal can provide first-pass comments in ~7 business days. Full negotiation typically takes 2-4 weeks depending on rounds, but we can compress by agreeing to phased sequencing as Rishi suggested.

4) For signatures, DocuSign is preferred — we'll send an NDA envelope and a separate draft MSA link so you have both.

If procurement confirms they need an SOW to issue a PO, Marissa can send a minimal pilot SOW (2-3 pages) that captures scope, success criteria, timeline, and pricing. That often speeds procurement.

Happy to jump on a short call with contracts/procurement if that helps move things faster.

Best,
